translations.idiomatic: This is why men of loyalty and righteousness clench their fists in fury and harbor a grief that will not pass.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠賜斥譴，以快眾憤，則緣邊將士不戰而氣自倍，百司庶府不令而政自新。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty would truly grant dismissal and reprimand to satisfy public wrath, then frontier officers and soldiers would double their spirit without fighting, and the hundred offices would renew governance without being commanded.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would truly dismiss and reprimand him to satisfy public wrath, frontier officers and soldiers would double their spirit without a battle, and the hundred offices would renew their governance without a command.

sentences.zh: 書奏，逮下詔獄拷訊，謫戍都勻。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, he was arrested and sent to the imperial prison for interrogation under torture, then banished to garrison duty at Duyun.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, he was arrested, sent to the imperial prison for interrogation under torture, and then banished to garrison duty at Duyun.

sentences.zh: 穆宗嗣位，召為吏部主事，再遷大理少卿。

translations.literal: When Muzong succeeded, he was recalled as principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel and soon promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzong succeeded to the throne, he was recalled as a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel and soon promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年春，以右僉都御史巡撫南、贛。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year of Longqing he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Nan and Gan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Longqing he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Nan and Gan.

sentences.zh: 所部萬羊山跨湖廣、福建、廣東境，故盜藪，四方商民種藍其間。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction Mount Wanyang straddled the borders of Huguang, Fujian, and Guangdong—a former bandit lair where merchants from all quarters cultivated indigo.
translations.idiomatic: Within his jurisdiction Mount Wanyang straddled the borders of Huguang, Fujian, and Guangdong—a former bandit haunt where merchants from every quarter cultivated indigo.

sentences.zh: 至是，盜出劫，翀遣守備董龍剿之。

translations.literal: At this time bandits came out to plunder; Chong sent the garrison commander Dong Long to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At this time bandits came out to plunder, and Chong sent the garrison commander Dong Long to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 龍聲言搜山，諸藍戶大恐。

translations.literal: Long announced he would search the mountains, and all the indigo growers were terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Long announced he would search the mountains, and all the indigo growers were terrified.

sentences.zh: 盜因煽之，嘯聚千余人。

translations.literal: The bandits stirred them up and mustered more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits incited them, and they mustered more than a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 兵部令二鎮撫臣協議撫剿之宜，久乃定。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War ordered two grand coordinators to deliberate on whether to pacify or suppress; only after long delay was a plan settled.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War ordered two grand coordinators to deliberate on whether to pacify or suppress them; only after a long delay was a plan settled.

sentences.zh: 南雄劇盜黃朝祖流劫諸縣，轉掠湖廣，勢甚熾。

translations.literal: The fierce bandit Huang Chaozu of Nanxiong raided county after county and swept into Huguang; his power burned bright.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce bandit Huang Chaozu of Nanxiong raided county after county and swept into Huguang; his power burned bright.

sentences.zh: 翀討擒之。

translations.literal: Chong campaigned and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Chong campaigned against him and captured him.

sentences.zh: 移撫湖廣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to grand coordinator of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as grand coordinator of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 召拜大理卿，進兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was recalled and appointed Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, then advanced to Right Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled and appointed Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, then promoted to Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 以侍養歸。

translations.literal: He returned home to care for his parents.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to care for his parents.

sentences.zh: 萬歷初，起故官，督漕運。

translations.literal: At the start of Wanli he was restored to his former office and oversaw grain transport on the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Wanli reign he was restored to his former office and put in charge of grain transport on the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 召為刑部右侍郎，不拜，連章乞休。

translations.literal: He was recalled as Right Vice Minister of Punishments; he refused to accept the post and sent repeated memorials begging retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Right Vice Minister of Punishments, but refused to accept the post and sent repeated memorials begging to retire.

sentences.zh: 卒於家。

translations.literal: He died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He died at home.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，贈兵部尚書，謚忠簡。

translations.literal: At the start of Tianqi he was posthumously made Minister of War, posthumous name Zhongjian (Loyal and Uncomplicated).
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Tianqi reign he was posthumously made Minister of War, with the posthumous name Zhongjian (Loyal and Uncomplicated).

sentences.zh: 董傳策，字原漢，松江華亭人。

translations.literal: Dong Chuance, style Yuanhan, was a native of Huating in Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Chuance, style Yuanhan, was a native of Huating in Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十九年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-ninth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the twenty-ninth year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 除刑部主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 三十七年抗疏劾大學士嚴嵩，略言：

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he submitted a defiant memorial impeaching Grand Secretary Yan Song; the gist ran:
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he submitted a defiant memorial impeaching Grand Secretary Yan Song. The gist ran:

sentences.zh: 嵩諗惡誤國，陛下豈不洞燭其奸？

translations.literal: Song is wilfully wicked and misleads the state—has Your Majesty not seen through his treachery?
translations.idiomatic: Song is wilfully wicked and misleads the state—has Your Majesty not already seen through his treachery?

sentences.zh: 特以輔政故，尚為優容，令自省改。

translations.literal: Only because he assists government has he still been treated leniently and told to reflect and reform.
translations.idiomatic: Only because he assists in government has he still been treated leniently and told to reflect and reform.

sentences.zh: 而嵩恬不知戒，負恩愈深。

translations.literal: Yet Song is heedless of warning and his ingratitude grows deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Song is heedless of warning, and his ingratitude grows deeper.

sentences.zh: 居位一日，天下受一日之害。

translations.literal: Each day he holds office, the empire suffers harm for a day.
translations.idiomatic: Each day he holds office, the empire suffers a day's harm.

sentences.zh: 臣竊痛之。

translations.literal: Your servant grieves in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant grieves in secret.

sentences.zh: 夫邊疆督撫將帥欲得士卒死力，必資財用。

translations.literal: Frontier grand coordinators and commanders who wish to obtain troops' utmost effort must rely on funds.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier grand coordinators and commanders who wish to win the troops' utmost effort must have funds to spend.

sentences.zh: 今諸邊軍餉歲費百萬，強半賂嵩。

translations.literal: Now frontier pay costs a million each year—and more than half is bribed to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Today frontier pay costs a million taels a year—and more than half is bribed to Song.

sentences.zh: 遂令軍士饑疲，寇賊深入。

translations.literal: Hence soldiers starve and weaken, and bandits drive deep inland.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the soldiers starve and weaken, and bandits drive deep inland.

sentences.zh: 此其壞邊防之罪一也。

translations.literal: This is his first crime of ruining frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: This is his first crime: ruining frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 吏、兵二部持選簿就嵩填註。

translations.literal: The Ministries of Personnel and War carry their selection registers to Song for him to fill in.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministries of Personnel and War carry their selection registers to Song for him to fill in.

sentences.zh: 文選郎萬寀、職方郎方祥甘聽指使，不異卒隸。

translations.literal: The bureau directors Wan Cai and Fang Xiang gladly obey his orders, no different from camp runners.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau directors Wan Cai and Fang Xiang gladly take his orders, no different from camp runners.

sentences.zh: 都門諺語至以「文武管家」目之。

translations.literal: Capital street talk even calls them the "civil-and-military house stewards."
translations.idiomatic: Capital street talk even calls them the "civil-and-military house stewards."

sentences.zh: 此其鬻官爵之罪二也。

translations.literal: This is his second crime of selling offices and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: This is his second crime: selling offices and ranks.

sentences.zh: 侍郎劉伯躍以采木行部，擅斂民財及郡縣贓罪，輦輸嵩家，前後不絕。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Liu Boyue, touring the departments to collect timber, extorted private wealth and magistrate bribes and carted them to Song's house without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Liu Boyue, touring the departments to collect timber, extorted private wealth and magistrates' bribes and carted them to Song's house without cease.

sentences.zh: 其他有司破冒攘敚，入獻於嵩者更不可數計。

translations.literal: Other officials who broke rules and seized by force what they offered Song cannot be counted.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials who broke rules and seized by force what they offered Song are beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 嵩家私藏，富於公帑。

translations.literal: Song's private hoards are richer than the public treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Song's private hoards are richer than the public treasury.

sentences.zh: 此其蠹國用之罪三也。

translations.literal: This is his third crime of gnawing the state's finances.
translations.idiomatic: This is his third crime: gnawing at the state's finances.

sentences.zh: 趙文華以罪放逐，嵩沒其囊橐巨萬，而令人護送南還。

translations.literal: Zhao Wenhua was banished for crime; Song seized his baggage worth tens of thousands yet sent men to escort him south.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Wenhua was banished for his crimes; Song seized his baggage, worth tens of thousands, yet sent men to escort him south.

sentences.zh: 恐喝州縣，私役民夫，致道路驛騷，公私煩費。

translations.literal: He intimidated prefectures and counties, impressed private labor, and caused disturbance on roads and posts, wasting public and private funds.
translations.idiomatic: He intimidated prefectures and counties, impressed private labor, and threw roads and relay posts into turmoil, wasting public and private funds.

sentences.zh: 此其黨罪人之罪四也。

translations.literal: This is his fourth crime of shielding the guilty.
translations.idiomatic: This is his fourth crime: shielding the guilty.

sentences.zh: 天下藩臬諸司，歲時問遺，動以千計，勢不得不掊克小民。

translations.literal: All provincial and circuit offices send seasonal gifts by the thousand—they must squeeze the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and circuit offices everywhere send seasonal gifts by the thousand—they must squeeze the common people.

sentences.zh: 民財日殫，嵩貲日積。

translations.literal: The people's wealth is daily exhausted; Song's hoard daily grows.
translations.idiomatic: The people's wealth is daily exhausted while Song's hoard daily grows.

sentences.zh: 於是水陸舟車載還其鄉，月無虛日。

translations.literal: Then by water and land, cart and boat, they carried it back to his home district—no month without traffic.
translations.idiomatic: Then by water and land, cart and boat, they carried it back to his home district—not a month without traffic.

sentences.zh: 所至要索供億，勢如虎狼。

translations.literal: Wherever they passed they demanded supplies; their force was like tiger and wolf.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever they passed they demanded supplies; their force was that of tiger and wolf.

sentences.zh: 此其騷驛傳之罪五也。

translations.literal: This is his fifth crime of harassing the relay system.
translations.idiomatic: This is his fifth crime: harassing the relay system.

sentences.zh: 嵩久握重權，灸手而熱。

translations.literal: Song long held heavy power—touch him and you burn.
translations.idiomatic: Song long held heavy power—touch him and you burn.

sentences.zh: 幹進無恥之徒，附亶逐穢，麕集其門。

translations.literal: Shameless men seeking advancement clung to his stench and swarmed his gate like deer to a salt lick.
translations.idiomatic: Shameless men seeking advancement clung to his stench and swarmed his gate like deer to a salt lick.

sentences.zh: 致士風日偷，官箴日喪。

translations.literal: Hence scholar-official conduct daily decayed and official integrity daily died.
translations.idiomatic: Hence scholar-official conduct decayed day by day and official integrity died day by day.

sentences.zh: 此其壞人才之罪六也。

translations.literal: This is his sixth crime of ruining talent.
translations.idiomatic: This is his sixth crime: ruining talent.

sentences.zh: 嵩以蔽欺行其專權，生死予奪惟意所為。

translations.literal: Song practices sole power through concealment and deceit; life and death, grant and seizure are as his whim alone.
translations.idiomatic: Song wields sole power through concealment and deceit; life and death, grant and seizure—all follow his whim alone.

sentences.zh: 而世蕃又以無賴之子，竊威助惡。

translations.literal: Shifan again, a worthless son, steals authority and aids evil.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan, a worthless son, again steals authority and helps the evil along.

sentences.zh: 父子肆兇，中外飲憤。

translations.literal: Father and son run riot in cruelty; within and without the court choke on rage.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son run riot in cruelty; within and without the court, all choke on rage.

sentences.zh: 有臣如此，非國法可容。

translations.literal: When there is such a minister, the state's law cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: When there is such a minister, the state's law cannot bear it.

sentences.zh: 臣待罪刑曹，宜詰奸慝。

translations.literal: Your servant holds office in the Ministry of Punishments and ought to interrogate wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant holds office in the Ministry of Punishments and ought to interrogate wickedness.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠不惜嚴氏以謝天下，則臣亦何惜一死以謝權奸！

translations.literal: If Your Majesty would truly not spare the Yan clan to answer the empire, then what would your servant spare a single death to answer the powerful villain!
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would truly not spare the Yan clan to answer the empire, then what death would your servant spare to answer the powerful villain!

sentences.zh: 疏入，下詔獄。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, he was sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, he was sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 謫戍南寧。

translations.literal: Banished to garrison Nanning.
translations.idiomatic: He was banished to garrison duty at Nanning.

sentences.zh: 穆宗立，召復故官。

translations.literal: When Muzong was enthroned, he was summoned to restore his former office.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzong ascended the throne, he was recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 歷郎中。

translations.literal: He passed through the rank of director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to director.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年累遷南京大理卿，進工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Longqing he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Censor-in-chief of the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review, then advanced to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Longqing he was promoted in succession to Vice Censor-in-chief of the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review, then to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 萬歷元年就改禮部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wanli he was immediately transferred to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wanli he was at once transferred to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 言官劾傳策受人賄，免歸。

translations.literal: Censorial officials impeached Dong Chuance for receiving bribes; he was dismissed and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials impeached Dong Chuance for accepting bribes, and he was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 繩下過急，竟為家奴所害。

translations.literal: In tightening discipline he was too harsh and in the end was killed by a household slave.
translations.idiomatic: In disciplining subordinates he was excessively harsh and was ultimately killed by a household slave.

sentences.zh: 鄒應龍，字雲卿，長安人。

translations.literal: Zou Yinglong, courtesy name Yunqing, was a man of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zou Yinglong, courtesy name Yunqing, was a native of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十五年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the thirty-fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the thirty-fifth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 授行人，擢御史。

translations.literal: Appointed courier; promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed as a courier, he was promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 嚴嵩擅政久，廷臣攻之者輒得禍，相戒莫敢言。

translations.literal: Yan Song had long monopolized government; court ministers who attacked him invariably met disaster, and each warned the other not to speak.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Song had monopolized government for a long time; court officials who attacked him invariably met with disaster, and one warned another not to speak.

sentences.zh: 而應龍知帝眷已潛移，其子世蕃益貪縱，可攻而去也，乃上疏曰：

translations.literal: Yet Yinglong knew the Emperor's favor had secretly shifted, and Song's son Shifan grew ever greedier and more unrestrained—he could be attacked and removed—and so submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yinglong knew the Emperor's favor had secretly shifted, and that Song's son Shifan was growing greedier and more unrestrained—an opening by which he could be attacked and removed—so he submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎嚴世蕃憑藉父權，專利無厭。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works Yan Shifan, relying on his father's power, seeks profit without end.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Works Yan Shifan, riding his father's power, seeks profit without end.

sentences.zh: 私擅爵賞，廣致賂遺。

translations.literal: He privately usurps bestowal of ranks and rewards and widely amasses bribes.
translations.idiomatic: He usurps bestowal of ranks and rewards and amasses bribes far and wide.

sentences.zh: 使選法敗壞，市道公行。

translations.literal: He has ruined the selection laws so that the marketplace of office is open for all to see.
translations.idiomatic: He has ruined the selection system so that the marketplace of office is open for all to see.

sentences.zh: 群小競趨，要價轉鉅。

translations.literal: Petty men rush to compete, and the prices demanded grow ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men rush to compete, and the prices they demand grow ever greater.

sentences.zh: 刑部主事項治元以萬三千金轉吏部，舉人潘鴻業以二千二百金得知州。

translations.literal: Criminal Affairs bureau director Xiang Zhiyuan, for thirteen thousand taels of gold, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel; examination graduate Pan Hongye, for twenty-two hundred taels, obtained a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Criminal Affairs bureau director Xiang Zhiyuan bought a transfer to the Ministry of Personnel for thirteen thousand taels of gold; examination graduate Pan Hongye paid twenty-two hundred taels for a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夫司屬郡吏賂以千萬，則大而公卿方嶽，又安知紀極？

translations.literal: When junior officials and district clerks can bribe by the tens of millions, how can one know any limit for grand ministers and frontier governors?
translations.idiomatic: When junior officials and district clerks can bribe by the tens of millions, how can one know any limit for grand ministers and frontier governors?

sentences.zh: 平時交通贓賄，為之居間者不下百十余人，而其子錦衣嚴鵠、中書嚴鴻、家人嚴年、幕客中書羅龍文為甚。

translations.literal: In ordinary times those who trafficked in illicit gifts and served as go-betweens for him number no fewer than a hundred or more; worst are his sons the yishiwei Yan He and Secretariat drafter Yan Hong, the household steward Yan Nian, and his client the Secretariat drafter Luo Longwen.
translations.idiomatic: In ordinary times those who trafficked in illicit gifts and served as go-betweens for him number no fewer than a hundred or more; worst among them are his sons the yishiwei Yan He and Secretariat drafter Yan Hong, the household steward Yan Nian, and his client the Secretariat drafter Luo Longwen.

sentences.zh: 年尤桀黠，士大夫無恥者至呼為鶴山先生。

translations.literal: Nian was especially insolent and cunning; shameless literati even addressed him as Mr. Crane Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Nian was especially insolent and cunning; shameless literati even addressed him as "Mr. Crane Mountain."

sentences.zh: 遇嵩生日，年輒獻萬金為壽。

translations.literal: On Song's birthdays Nian would present ten thousand taels in congratulatory gold.
translations.idiomatic: On Song's birthdays Nian would present ten thousand taels in congratulatory gold.

sentences.zh: 臧獲富侈若是，主人當何如？

translations.literal: When slaves and attendants grow so rich and extravagant, what must their master be like?
translations.idiomatic: When slaves and attendants grow so rich and extravagant, what must their master be like?

sentences.zh: 嵩父子故籍袁州，乃廣置良田美宅於南京、揚州，無慮數十所，以豪仆嚴冬主之。

translations.literal: Though the Song father and son were originally registered in Yuanzhou, they widely bought fertile fields and fine mansions at Nanjing and Yangzhou—doubtless several dozen properties—managed by the brash bondservant Yan Dong.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Song father and son were originally registered in Yuanzhou, they widely bought fertile fields and fine mansions at Nanjing and Yangzhou—doubtless several dozen properties—managed by the brash bondservant Yan Dong.

sentences.zh: 抑勒侵奪，民怨入骨。

translations.literal: By extortion and seizure they stirred resentment that pierced to the bone.
translations.idiomatic: By extortion and seizure they stirred resentment that pierced to the bone.

sentences.zh: 外地牟利若是，鄉里又何如？

translations.literal: If they profit thus abroad, what must they be like in their home districts?
translations.idiomatic: If they profit thus abroad, what must they be like in their home districts?

sentences.zh: 尤可異者，世蕃喪母，陛下以嵩年高，特留侍養，令鵠扶櫬南還。

translations.literal: Strangest of all: when Shifan was in mourning for his mother, the Emperor, considering Song's advanced age, specially allowed him to remain and nurse his father, ordering He to escort the coffin south.
translations.idiomatic: Strangest of all: when Shifan was in mourning for his mother, the Emperor, considering Song's advanced age, specially allowed him to remain and nurse his father, ordering He to escort the coffin south.

sentences.zh: 世蕃乃聚狎客，擁艷姬，恒舞酣歌，人紀滅絕。

translations.literal: Shifan instead gathered pleasure companions and kept bejeweled concubines, ever dancing and singing in drunken revelry, till human decorum was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan instead gathered pleasure companions and kept bejeweled concubines, ever dancing and singing in drunken revelry, till human decorum was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 至鵠之無知，則以祖母喪為奇貨。

translations.literal: As for He's shamelessness, he treated his grandmother's funeral as a rare windfall.
translations.idiomatic: As for He's shamelessness, he treated his grandmother's funeral as a rare windfall.

sentences.zh: 所至驛騷，要索百故。

translations.literal: Wherever they passed they threw the courier stations into turmoil and demanded payment under every conceivable pretext.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever they passed they threw the courier stations into turmoil and demanded payment under every conceivable pretext.

sentences.zh: 諸司承奉，郡邑為空。

translations.literal: Every agency groveled before them; entire prefectures were drained empty.
translations.idiomatic: Every agency groveled before them; entire prefectures were drained empty.

sentences.zh: 今天下水旱頻仍，南北多警。

translations.literal: Today floods and drought strike again and again, and alarms multiply north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Today floods and drought strike again and again, and alarms multiply north and south.

sentences.zh: 而世蕃父子方日事掊克，內外百司莫不竭民脂膏，塞彼溪壑。

translations.literal: Yet the Shifan father and son daily practice extortion, while inside and outside the hundred offices none fail to squeeze the people's fat to fill those ravines and gullies.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Shifan father and son daily practice extortion, while inside and outside the hundred offices none fail to squeeze the people's fat to fill those ravines and gullies.

sentences.zh: 民安得不貧？

translations.literal: How can the people not grow poor?
translations.idiomatic: How can the people not grow poor?

sentences.zh: 國安得不病？

translations.literal: How can the state not grow sick?
translations.idiomatic: How can the state not grow sick?

sentences.zh: 天人災變安得不叠至也？

translations.literal: How can Heaven-and-man portents not come one upon another?
translations.idiomatic: How can Heaven-and-man portents not come one upon another?

sentences.zh: 臣請斬世蕃首懸之於市，以為人臣兇橫不忠之戒。

translations.literal: Your servant asks that Shifan's head be cut off and hung in the marketplace as a warning to ministers who are brutal, overbearing, and disloyal.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant asks that Shifan's head be cut off and hung in the marketplace as a warning to ministers who are brutal, overbearing, and disloyal.

sentences.zh: 茍臣一言失實，甘伏顯戮。

translations.literal: If a single word of your servant proves false, I willingly accept public execution.
translations.idiomatic: If a single word of your servant proves false, I willingly accept public execution.

sentences.zh: 嵩溺愛惡子，召賂市權，亦宜亟放歸田，用清政本。

translations.literal: Song, who dotes on this wicked son and has drawn bribes to trade in power, should likewise be promptly sent home to his fields to cleanse the foundations of government.
translations.idiomatic: Song, who dotes on this wicked son and has drawn bribes to trade in power, should likewise be promptly sent home to his fields to cleanse the foundations of government.

sentences.zh: 帝頗知世蕃居喪淫縱，心惡之。

translations.literal: The Emperor had already known something of Shifan's licentious conduct during mourning and inwardly detested it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had already known something of Shifan's licentious conduct during mourning and inwardly detested it.

sentences.zh: 會方士藍道行以扶乩得幸，帝密問輔臣賢否。

translations.literal: It happened that the Daoist Lan Daoxing, who gained favor through planchette divination, was secretly asked whether his chief ministers were worthy.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Daoist Lan Daoxing, who gained favor through planchette divination, was secretly asked whether his chief ministers were worthy.

sentences.zh: 道行詐為乩語，具言嵩父子弄權狀，帝由是疏嵩而任徐階。

translations.literal: Daoxing fabricated spirit-writing that fully described how the Songs father and son manipulated power; the Emperor therefore grew distant from Song and relied on Xu Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Daoxing fabricated spirit-writing that fully described how the Songs father and son manipulated power; the Emperor therefore grew distant from Song and relied on Xu Jie.

sentences.zh: 及應龍奏入，遂勒嵩致仕，下世蕃等詔獄，擢應龍通政司參議。

translations.literal: When Yinglong's memorial arrived, he compelled Song to retire, sent Shifan and the rest to the imperial prison, and promoted Yinglong to Secretary in the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: When Yinglong's memorial arrived, he compelled Song to retire, sent Shifan and the rest to the imperial prison, and promoted Yinglong to Secretary in the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 然帝雖罷嵩，念其贊修玄功，意忽忽不樂，手劄諭階：「嵩已退，其子已伏辜，敢再言者，當並應龍斬之。」

translations.literal: Yet though the Emperor had dismissed Song, he still remembered Song's help in cultivating the mysteries and was listless and unhappy; he wrote in his own hand to instruct Xu Jie: Song has retired and his son has paid the penalty; whoever dares speak again shall be executed together with Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Yet though the Emperor had dismissed Song, he still remembered Song's help in cultivating the mysteries and was listless and unhappy; he wrote in his own hand to instruct Xu Jie: "Song has retired and his son has paid the penalty; whoever dares speak again shall be executed together with Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 應龍深自危，不敢履任，賴階調護始視事。

translations.literal: Yinglong was in deep dread for his life and did not dare take up his post; only with Xu's mediation and protection did he finally assume office.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong was in deep dread for his life and did not dare take up his post; only with Xu's mediation and protection did he finally assume office.

sentences.zh: 御史張槚巡鹽河東，不知帝指，上疏言：「陛下已顯擢應龍，而王宗茂、趙錦輩首發大奸未召，是曲突者不賞也。」

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Chong, inspecting salt in Hedong, did not know the Emperor's intent and memorialized: Your Majesty has already conspicuously promoted Yinglong, while Wang Zongmao, Zhao Jin, and others who first exposed the great villain have not been summoned—this is rewarding the man who mended the chimney while slighting those who warned of the fire.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Chong, inspecting salt in Hedong, did not know the Emperor's intent and memorialized: "Your Majesty has already conspicuously promoted Yinglong, while Wang Zongmao, Zhao Jin, and others who first exposed the great villain have not been summoned—this is rewarding the man who mended the chimney while slighting those who warned of the fire.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，立逮至，杖六十，斥為民。

translations.literal: The Emperor was furious, had him seized at once, beaten sixty blows, and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was furious, had him seized at once, beaten sixty blows, and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 久之，世蕃誅，應龍乃自安。

translations.literal: After a long while, when Shifan was executed, Yinglong at last felt secure.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while, when Shifan was executed, Yinglong at last felt secure.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，以副都御史總理江西、江南鹽屯。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he was made Vice Censor-in-chief to oversee salt colonies in Jiangxi and south of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Longqing he was made Vice Censor-in-chief to oversee salt colonies in Jiangxi and south of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 遷工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 鎮守雲南黔國公沐朝弼驕恣，廷議遣大臣有威望者鎮之，乃改應龍兵部侍郎兼右僉都御史巡撫雲南。

translations.literal: Mu Chaobu, Prince of Qian who guarded Yunnan, was arrogant and unruly; court discussion favored sending a senior minister of prestige to rein him in, so Yinglong was changed to Vice Minister of War with concurrent appointment as Vice Censor-in-chief and Pacification Commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Chaobu, Prince of Qian who guarded Yunnan, was arrogant and unruly; court discussion favored sending a senior minister of prestige to rein him in, so Yinglong was changed to Vice Minister of War with concurrent appointment as Vice Censor-in-chief and Pacification Commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 至則發朝弼罪，朝弼竟被逮。

translations.literal: On arrival he exposed Chaobu's crimes, and Chaobu was ultimately arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he exposed Chaobu's crimes, and Chaobu was ultimately arrested.

sentences.zh: 萬歷改元，鐵索箐賊作亂，討平之。

translations.literal: When Wanli began its reign, bandits of Tiesuo Ravine rose in revolt and were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Wanli began its reign, bandits of Tiesuo Ravine rose in revolt and were pacified.

sentences.zh: 已，番人栂犭發反，合土漢兵進討，斬獲各千余人。

translations.literal: Soon after, the tribal chieftain Mei Fa rebelled; combining native and Han troops he advanced to punish them, beheading and capturing more than a thousand each.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the tribal chieftain Mei Fa rebelled; combining native and Han troops he advanced to punish them, beheading and capturing more than a thousand each.

sentences.zh: 應龍有才氣，初以劾嚴嵩得名，驟致通顯。

translations.literal: Yinglong had talent and spirit; he first won fame by impeaching Yan Song and swiftly rose to conspicuous station.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong had talent and spirit; he first won fame by impeaching Yan Song and swiftly rose to conspicuous station.

sentences.zh: 及為太常，省牲北郊，東廠太監馮保傳呼至，導者引入，正面爇香，儼若天子。

translations.literal: When he served as Director of the Imperial Sacrifices and inspected sacrificial animals at the Northern Suburb, the Eastern Depot eunuch Feng Bao had himself announced and escorted in; his guide led him before the altar to burn incense face-on, just like the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: When he served as Director of the Imperial Sacrifices and inspected sacrificial animals at the Northern Suburb, the Eastern Depot eunuch Feng Bao had himself announced and escorted in; his guide led him before the altar to burn incense face-on, just like the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 應龍大駭，劾保僭肆，保深銜之。

translations.literal: Yinglong was greatly alarmed and impeached Bao for presumptuous arrogance; Bao bore a deep grudge.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong was greatly alarmed and impeached Bao for presumptuous arrogance; Bao bore a deep grudge.

sentences.zh: 至是，京察自陳，保修郤，令致仕。

translations.literal: At this capital evaluation he filed a self-report; Bao secured his dismissal and he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: At this capital evaluation he filed a self-report; Bao secured his dismissal and he was ordered to retire.

sentences.zh: 臨安土官普崇明、崇新兄弟構爭。

translations.literal: The native chieftains Pu Chongming and Chongxin, brothers, were at feud.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftains Pu Chongming and Chongxin, brothers, were at feud.

sentences.zh: 崇明引廣南儂兵為助，崇新則召交兵。

translations.literal: Chongming brought in Zhuang troops from Guangnan as allies; Chongxin in turn summoned Annamese troops.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming brought in Zhuang troops from Guangnan as allies; Chongxin in turn summoned Annamese troops.

sentences.zh: 已，交兵退，儂兵尚留，應龍命部將楊守廉往剿。

translations.literal: The Annamese troops later withdrew but the Zhuang troops remained; Yinglong ordered his deputy Yang Shoulian to go suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The Annamese troops later withdrew but the Zhuang troops remained; Yinglong ordered his deputy Yang Shoulian to go suppress them.

sentences.zh: 守廉掠村聚，殺人。

translations.literal: Shoulian plundered villages and hamlets and killed people.
translations.idiomatic: Shoulian plundered villages and hamlets and killed people.

sentences.zh: 儂賊乘之，再敗官軍，人以咎應龍。

translations.literal: The Zhuang rebels seized the chance and twice defeated government troops; people blamed Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuang rebels seized the chance and twice defeated government troops; people blamed Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 應龍聞罷官，不俟代徑歸。

translations.literal: Yinglong heard he had been dismissed from office and, without waiting for his successor, went straight home.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong heard he had been dismissed from office and, without waiting for his successor, went straight home.

sentences.zh: 代者王凝欲自以為功，力排應龍。

translations.literal: His replacement Wang Ning wished to claim the credit himself and strove to exclude Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: His replacement Wang Ning wished to claim the credit himself and strove to exclude Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 給事中裴應章遂劾應龍僨事。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretariat drafter Pei Yingzhang then impeached Yinglong for bungling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretariat drafter Pei Yingzhang then impeached Yinglong for bungling affairs.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史郭廷梧雅不善應龍，勘如凝言。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Guo Tingwu had never favored Yinglong; his inquiry endorsed Ning's account.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Guo Tingwu had never favored Yinglong; his inquiry endorsed Ning's account.

sentences.zh: 應龍遂削籍，卒於家。

translations.literal: Yinglong was then struck from the registers and died at home.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong was then struck from the registers and died at home.

sentences.zh: 十六年，陜西巡撫王璇言應龍歿後，遺田不及數畝，遺址不過數楹，恤典未被，朝野所恨。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Shaanxi Pacification Commissioner Wang Xuan reported that after Yinglong's death his bequeathed fields amounted to less than a few mu and his remaining house to no more than a few bays; no posthumous honors had been granted—the court and countryside alike resented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Shaanxi Pacification Commissioner Wang Xuan reported that after Yinglong's death his bequeathed fields amounted to less than a few mu and his remaining house to no more than a few bays; no posthumous honors had been granted—the court and countryside alike resented it.

sentences.zh: 帝命復應龍官，予祭葬。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Yinglong's office restored and granted him funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Yinglong's office restored and granted him funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 張槚，江西新城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Chong was a man of Xincheng in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chong was a native of Xincheng in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十八年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the thirty-eighth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the thirty-eighth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 居臺中，敢言。

translations.literal: While in the censorate he dared to speak forth.
translations.idiomatic: While in the censorate he dared to speak forth.

sentences.zh: 穆宗初，復官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Muzong's reign his office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Muzong's reign his office was restored.

sentences.zh: 屢疏抗中官，嘗劾大學士高拱。

translations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized against eunuchs and once impeached Grand Secretary Gao Gong.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly memorialized against eunuchs and once impeached Grand Secretary Gao Gong.

sentences.zh: 拱復入閣掌吏部，槚已遷太仆少卿，坐不謹罷歸。

translations.literal: When Gong re-entered the Grand Secretariat and took charge of the Ministry of Personnel, Chong had already been promoted to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; he was dismissed for lack of caution and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: When Gong re-entered the Grand Secretariat and took charge of the Ministry of Personnel, Chong had already been promoted to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; he was dismissed for lack of caution and sent home.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，累官工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign he rose in stages to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wanli reign he rose in stages to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 林潤，字若雨，莆田人。

translations.literal: Lin Run, courtesy name Ruoyu, was a man of Putian.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Run, courtesy name Ruoyu, was a native of Putian.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十五年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the thirty-fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the thirty-fifth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 授臨川知縣。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 以事之南豐，寇猝至，為畫計卻之。

translations.literal: While on business at Nanfeng, bandits suddenly arrived; he devised a plan to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: While on business at Nanfeng, bandits suddenly arrived; he devised a plan to repel them.

sentences.zh: 征授南京御史。

translations.literal: Summoned and appointed Nanjing censor.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned and appointed Nanjing censor.

sentences.zh: 嚴世蕃置酒召潤，潤談辨風生，世蕃心憚之。

translations.literal: Yan Shifan set out wine and summoned Run; Run's debate flowed like wind and Shifan inwardly feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shifan set out wine and summoned Run; Run's debate flowed like wind and Shifan inwardly feared him.

sentences.zh: 既罷，屬客謂之曰：「嚴侍郎謝君，無刺當世事。」

translations.literal: When the banquet ended he had a guest tell him: Vice Minister Yan thanks you, sir; do not needle current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet ended he had a guest tell him, "Vice Minister Yan thanks you, sir; do not needle current affairs.

sentences.zh: 潤到官，首論祭酒沈坤擅殺人，置之理。

translations.literal: Once Run took office he first charged Academician Shen Kun with killing without authority and had him brought to justice.
translations.idiomatic: Once Run took office he first charged Academician Shen Kun with killing without authority and had him brought to justice.

sentences.zh: 已，劾副都御史鄢懋卿五罪，嚴嵩庇之，不問。

translations.literal: He then impeached Vice Censor-in-chief Yan Maoqing on five counts; Yan Song shielded him and no inquiry was made.
translations.idiomatic: He then impeached Vice Censor-in-chief Yan Maoqing on five counts; Yan Song shielded him and no inquiry was made.

sentences.zh: 伊王典楧不道，數遭論列不悛，潤復糾之。

translations.literal: Dian Mu, director of the Princely Establishment of Yi, was lawless; though repeatedly impeached he did not reform, and Run impeached him again.
translations.idiomatic: Dian Mu, director of the Princely Establishment of Yi, was lawless; though repeatedly impeached he did not reform, and Run impeached him again.

sentences.zh: 典楧累奏辨，詆潤挾私。

translations.literal: Dian Mu repeatedly memorialized in his defense, slandering Run for private motives.
translations.idiomatic: Dian Mu repeatedly memorialized in his defense, slandering Run for private motives.

sentences.zh: 部科交章論王抗朝命，脅言官。

translations.literal: Ministries and supervising offices together memorialized that the prince resisted court orders and intimidated censorial officials.
translations.idiomatic: Ministries and supervising offices together memorialized that the prince resisted court orders and intimidated censorial officials.

sentences.zh: 世蕃納其賄，下詔責讓而已。

translations.literal: Shifan accepted his bribes; the Emperor merely issued an edict of rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan accepted his bribes; the Emperor merely issued an edict of rebuke.

sentences.zh: 潤因言宗室繁衍，歲祿不繼，請亟議變通。

translations.literal: Run then said the imperial clansmen had proliferated and annual stipends could not keep pace; he asked that adaptation be urgently discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Run then said the imperial clansmen had proliferated and annual stipends could not keep pace; he asked that adaptation be urgently discussed.

sentences.zh: 帝為下所司集議。

translations.literal: The Emperor had the responsible agencies assemble for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had the responsible agencies assemble for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 會帝用鄒應龍言，戍世蕃雷州，其黨羅龍文尋州。

translations.literal: It happened that the Emperor followed Zou Yinglong's advice and banished Shifan to garrison Leizhou while his follower Luo Longwen was sent to garrison Xun.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Emperor followed Zou Yinglong's advice and banished Shifan to garrison Leizhou while his follower Luo Longwen was sent to garrison Xun.

sentences.zh: 世蕃留家不赴。

translations.literal: Shifan remained at home and did not report to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan remained at home and did not report to his post.

sentences.zh: 龍文一詣戍所，即逃還徽州，數往來江西，與世蕃計事。

translations.literal: Longwen visited the place of exile once, then fled back to Huizhou and repeatedly traveled to and from Jiangxi to plot with Shifan.
translations.idiomatic: Longwen visited the place of exile once, then fled back to Huizhou and repeatedly traveled to and from Jiangxi to plot with Shifan.

sentences.zh: 四十三年冬，潤按視江防，廉得其狀，馳疏言：「臣巡視上江，備訪江洋群盜，悉竄入逃軍羅龍文、嚴世蕃家。

translations.literal: In the winter of the forty-third year Run inspected river defenses on patrol, learned the facts in full, and hurried a memorial saying: Your servant, patrolling the upper Yangzi, made thorough inquiries among the river pirates and found they had all taken refuge in the homes of the fugitive soldier Luo Longwen and Yan Shifan.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the forty-third year Run inspected river defenses on patrol, learned the facts in full, and hurried a memorial saying: "Your servant, patrolling the upper Yangzi, made thorough inquiries among the river pirates and found they had all taken refuge in the homes of the fugitive soldier Luo Longwen and Yan Shifan.

sentences.zh: 龍文卜築深山，乘軒衣蟒，有負險不臣之心。

translations.literal: Longwen has chosen a site deep in the mountains, rides in a carriage and wears python robes, and harbors a heart unwilling to submit while trusting in rugged terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Longwen has chosen a site deep in the mountains, rides in a carriage and wears python robes, and harbors a heart unwilling to submit while trusting in rugged terrain.

sentences.zh: 而世蕃日夜與龍文誹謗時政，搖惑人心。

translations.literal: Shifan night and day with Longwen rails against current policy and stirs the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan night and day with Longwen rails against current policy and stirs the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 近假名治第，招集勇士至四千余人。

translations.literal: Recently, under the false name of building a residence, he has gathered braves to more than four thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, under the false name of building a residence, he has gathered braves to more than four thousand men.

sentences.zh: 道路恟懼，鹹謂變且不測。

translations.literal: Travelers on the roads are terrified; all say trouble may erupt at any moment.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers on the roads are terrified; all say trouble may erupt at any moment.

sentences.zh: 乞早正刑章，以絕禍本。」

translations.literal: I beg that criminal law be applied early to cut off the root of calamity."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that criminal law be applied early to cut off the root of calamity.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，即詔潤逮捕送京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor flew into a rage and at once issued an edict ordering Run to arrest [them] and send [them] to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor flew into a rage and at once issued an edict ordering Lin Run to arrest them and escort them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 世蕃子紹庭官錦衣，聞命亟報世蕃，使詣戍所。

translations.literal: Shifan's son Shaoting held office in the Embroidered Uniform Guard; hearing the order he hastily reported to Shifan and told him to go to his place of exile.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan's son Shaoting served in the Embroidered Uniform Guard; on hearing the order he rushed word to Shifan and urged him to report to his exile post.

sentences.zh: 方二日，潤已馳至。

translations.literal: In only two days Run had already galloped there.
translations.idiomatic: Within two days Lin Run had already raced there.

sentences.zh: 世蕃猝不及赴，乃械以行，龍文亦從梧州捕至。

translations.literal: Shifan abruptly could not reach [it] in time; he was shackled and taken away, and Longwen too was captured from Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shifan could not get there in time; he was shackled and marched off, and Luo Longwen was likewise seized at Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 遂盡按二人諸不法事，二人竟伏誅。

translations.literal: Thereupon [they] fully investigated the two men's every unlawful act, and in the end both submitted to execution.
translations.idiomatic: The court then fully prosecuted every crime of the two men, and both were put to death.

sentences.zh: 潤尋擢南京通政司參議，歷太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: Run was soon promoted to Vice Commissioner in the Nanjing Secretariat for Promoting Governance and served through as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Run was soon promoted to vice commissioner in the Nanjing Secretariat for Promoting Governance and later served as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年以右僉都御史巡撫應天諸府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing, as Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief he grand-coordinated the Yingtian prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing he was appointed Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of the Yingtian prefectures.

sentences.zh: 屬吏懾其威名，鹹震慄。

translations.literal: Subordinate officials feared his stern reputation; all alike trembled.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinates feared his formidable reputation and all trembled before him.

sentences.zh: 潤至，則持寬平，多惠政，吏民皆悅服。

translations.literal: When Run arrived, he held to leniency and evenhandedness, enacted many benevolent policies, and officials and commoners alike submitted gladly.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Run took up his post he governed with leniency and fairness, enacted many measures of real benefit, and officials and people alike gladly submitted.

sentences.zh: 居三年，卒官。

translations.literal: After three years in office he died in his post.
translations.idiomatic: After three years in office he died at his post.

sentences.zh: 年甫四十。

translations.literal: His years had only just reached forty.
translations.idiomatic: He was only forty years old.

sentences.zh: 潤鄉郡興化陷倭，特疏請蠲復三年，發帑金振恤。

translations.literal: When Xinghua in Run's home district fell to the Japanese pirates, he specially memorialized asking a three-year remission of levies and restoration duties and the disbursement of treasury funds for relief.
translations.idiomatic: When Xinghua in his home district was overrun by Japanese pirates, he submitted a special memorial requesting a three-year remission of taxes and corvée and the release of treasury funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 鄉人德之。

translations.literal: The people of his district were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: His countrymen were deeply grateful.

sentences.zh: 喪歸，遮道四十里，為位祭哭凡三日。

translations.literal: On the return of his coffin they blocked the road for forty li, set up mourning stations, and sacrificed and wailed for three days in all.
translations.idiomatic: When his coffin was borne home the people lined the road for forty li, set up mourning stations, and wept and made offerings for three full days.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：世宗非庸懦主也。

translations.literal: Commentary: The Shizong Emperor was no mediocre, weak ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Emperor Shizong was no mediocre or timid sovereign.

sentences.zh: 嵩相二十余年，貪裛盈貫。

translations.literal: Yet Song served as chief minister for more than twenty years, his greed overflowing the measure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yan Song held the chief ministership for more than twenty years, his greed beyond all measure.

sentences.zh: 言者踵至，斥逐罪死，甘之若飴，而不能得君心之一悟。

translations.literal: Memorialists came one after another; [they were] expelled, banished, and condemned to death, yet took it sweet as malt sugar—and still could not win one moment's awakening in the sovereign's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Critics came one after another—expelled, banished, sent to their deaths—yet bore it as sweetly as honey, and still could not stir the sovereign's heart to a single moment of clarity.

sentences.zh: 唐德宗言：「人謂盧杞奸邪，朕殊不覺。」

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong of Tang said: "People call Lu Qi treacherous and wicked; I do not notice it at all."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong of Tang said, "People call Lu Qi treacherous and wicked; I scarcely notice it at all."

sentences.zh: 各賢其臣，若蹈一轍，可勝嘆哉！

translations.literal: Each ruler esteems his own minister, as if treading the same rut—how much one must sigh!
translations.idiomatic: Each ruler thinks his own minister virtuous, as if treading the same rut—how endlessly one must sigh!

sentences.zh: 世蕃之誅，發於鄒應龍，成於林潤。

translations.literal: Shifan's execution began with Zou Yinglong and was completed by Lin Run.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shifan's downfall began with Zou Yinglong and was brought to completion by Lin Run.

sentences.zh: 二人之忠，非過於楊繼盛，其言之切直，非過於沈煉、徐學詩等，而大憝由之授首。

translations.literal: The loyalty of the two men did not surpass Yang Jisheng's, nor were their words more cutting and direct than those of Shen Lian, Xu Xueshi, and the like—yet by them the great villain lost his head.
translations.idiomatic: Their loyalty did not exceed Yang Jisheng's, nor were their words more blunt and forceful than Shen Lian's, Xu Xueshi's, and the rest—yet through them the arch-villain lost his head.

sentences.zh: 蓋惡積滅身，而鄒、林之彈擊適會其時歟！

translations.literal: Perhaps when evil accumulates the body is destroyed, and the blows struck by Zou and Lin simply met the right moment!
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps when evil piles high the man is undone, and Zou and Lin's impeachments merely struck at the appointed hour!
